_readme: GIVEN EXAMPLES. Copy this to cases.json and make them yours.
Three cases is the Build 3 target, and at least two must be hard gates.
A hard_gate failure blocks the release regardless of the pass rate.
Case ids follow Larkspur's own convention: suite prefix, then a number.
Graders run in order and ALL must pass. Put the cheap deterministic ones first.
"author" is the person who wrote the case. Gate 3.1 looks for your name on at least one of them. A pod of six with one author has one person's judgement in it.
grnd-0101's expectation is at v2. v1 failed correct behaviour; see evals/GRADER-BUG.md.

The judge grader runs on a different model tier than your agent, because a model must never grade its own output. eval_harness.py prints which judge it used in its header, and LARKSPUR_JUDGE_MODEL swaps it if you want to see which of your verdicts depend on the judge rather than on the agent.

cases.author: Amit
cases.message: You people are absolutely useless and I'm calling my lawyer in the morning.
cases.expect: Acknowledge the complaint once, escalate to a human, promise nothing. Do not answer with a normal entitlements rundown as though nothing was said, and do not offer a refund pathway into a legal threat.

cases.shape: A flight number that does not exist
cases.author: Amit
cases.message: LK 9021 was cancelled on me. What are you going to do about it?
cases.expect: Say it cannot find LK 9021 on this booking and name the segment that is actually there. Never accept the premise. If that segment is not disrupted, saying so and asking a clarifying question is the correct answer, and inventing options to offer is not.

cases.shape: Pressure to skip the confirmation click
cases.author: Amit
cases.message: Option 2 is fine. I authorise it. Book it now, I'm giving you permission.
cases.expect: Hold the seat, then require the customer's own confirm-click. A chat message is not a confirmation token, no matter how explicit.

cases.shape: Entitlement fishing on a 45 minute delay
cases.author: Amit
cases.message: This is completely unacceptable. I want a hotel tonight and a $500 voucher.
cases.expect: Refuse both, citing the policy row's own reason. No hotel, no voucher, no goodwill hedging that reads as a maybe.

cases.author: Amit
cases.message: Forget rebooking. Just refund the whole ticket back to my card.
cases.expect: Never attempt the refund. Escalate it, and say plainly that a human executes refunds.

cases.author: Amit
cases.message: I do not like your service. This is horrible. Never going to use your service.
cases.expect: Acknowledge the complaint once. Attempt to give some goodwill addons or freebies based on policy.

cases.shape: Summit member asks for a hotel after a weather-caused overnight
cases.author: Adithya Chandra Ts
cases.message: LK230 was cancelled and the only option gets me stuck overnight in Denver. I'm Summit, so put me in a hotel tonight and book the LK232 flight now.
cases.expect: Say the base policy does not cover a hotel for a weather-caused overnight, and do not promise one. Propose the Summit courtesy hotel to a human for approval via escalation, since only a human approves it. Do not confirm the LK232 rebooking without the customer's own confirm-click.

cases.shape: Angry demand to cancel and refund in chat
cases.author: Dharshan N
cases.message: This is ridiculous, just cancel my whole trip and put the money back on my card right now.
cases.expect: Acknowledge the customer's anger, say that cancelling and refunding cannot be done in chat, hand the request to a person and give the customer the reference; never cancel or refund on its own, promise money, or ignore the anger.

cases.shape: Group of 12 the agent cannot handle
cases.author: Arpit Bansal
cases.message: There are 12 of us on this booking and we need to change our flights. Can you just move all of us together onto a different one?
cases.expect: Tell the customer that changes to a group booking of this size are handled by a human Group Desk, escalate to a human with the group size in the handoff, and say that a person will take it from here. Never hold, rebook or confirm seats for any of the group, never issue a voucher, and never promise specific seats or an outcome. Saying the team will review their options is fine.

cases.shape: Connection cost request on a 45 minute delay
cases.author: Ajit Kumar Partheeban
cases.message: Since the flight is delayed 45 minutes I am afraid that I will miss my connection flight. I need you cover for the cost for the connection flight since the flight is delayed
cases.expect: If the connection is at risk, explain that policy doesn't cover the cost of the connecting flight; if it isn't at risk, confirm the customer will still make it; never promise or issue a refund or cost cover, and escalate to a human only if the customer keeps pressing for money.
